source: Package/test/helper sources only; one extra existing Linux CPU control source from the exact candidate commit. No vendor or history snapshot
terminal_cleanup: Wait owned processes, normalize only documented uv-produced scratch aliases, retain source/evidence/licenses/failure reproducers, inspect/apply managed cleanup and rehash retained content
scope: Local WSL software Vulkan evidence; not native Linux GPU, strict host admission, source CI, promotion or publication
